verdict.rationale: Figma ships an in-product agent that can generate design directions, search your files and let you refine work with suggestions (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-51). One community report describes its AI summarizing a user's notes and data into slides (figma-comm-9), which is the closest match to insights from data. The AI is mainly generative design help, not analysis of the user's data, and one user calls the FigJam AI tools 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analysis of user or file data (library analytics are not AI-driven), first-party docs on suggestion features, and hands-on corroboration that the AI tools work reliably.
